cost: offline, $0 -- reads m43_predictor_scores.csv and m44_decision.json, folds nothing
question: The manuscript claims that no implementation is distinguishable from a free integer as a standalone ranker, and supports it with twelve confidence intervals that cover zero. A confidence interval covering zero is a failure to reject a difference, not evidence of equivalence. This run replaces that argument with a formal one.
why_this_is_not_optional: The paper makes exactly this criticism of itself elsewhere: C8's channel was downgraded from 'empty' to 'unresolved' because its interval, while covering zero, reached far enough to permit the whole effect. The same standard has to apply to Reading 2 or the paper holds two standards.

An equivalence claim needs a margin. Without one, 'indistinguishable' means only that this corpus was too small to resolve a difference, which is a statement about our sample and not about the models.

the_margin_and_how_it_is_fixed.rule: delta_tube is the recovery gain that ONE additional construct buys in a design cell of median size, at the operative budget. A ranker difference smaller than that is one an experimenter removes by building one more tube, so it cannot change a decision.
the_margin_and_how_it_is_fixed.computation: slope of recovery against budget for the FREE DEPTH baseline, evaluated between the smallest and largest declared budgets, multiplied by 1/median(cell size). Depth alone, so the margin never touches the model-versus-depth quantities it will be applied to.
the_margin_and_how_it_is_fixed.why_this_rule_and_not_a_number: delta cannot be chosen after seeing the differences it will judge. It is therefore derived from a rule that involves only the free baseline and the corpus geometry, both fixed before any model enters.
the_margin_and_how_it_is_fixed.not_to_be_rechosen: delta_tube is whatever the rule returns. It is not adjusted after the equivalence bounds are read.

the_ungameable_quantity.name: minimum equivalence margin, delta_star
the_ungameable_quantity.definition: the smallest margin at which two one-sided tests at alpha = 0.05 would declare equivalence, which is the larger absolute endpoint of the 90 per cent target-clustered bootstrap interval on the difference.
the_ungameable_quantity.why_it_matters: it is reported for every comparison so that a reader who rejects our delta can apply their own. A claim of equivalence at a margin the reader does not accept is then visibly a claim about that margin rather than about the models.

arms.V: reproduce M44's twelve point estimates before anything else
arms.E1: delta_star for all twelve implementation-minus-depth comparisons, at all three budgets
arms.E2: delta_tube from the frozen rule, and which comparisons are equivalent at it
arms.E3: the four depth-then-model arms, where the paper DOES claim a difference -- a positive control that should not come out equivalent if the claim is real
arms.E4: depth against itself: delta_star must be at the numerical floor

staked.1: every implementation-minus-depth comparison is equivalent to free depth at delta_tube, at every budget
staked.2: depth against itself returns delta_star below 0.001
staked.3: at least one depth-then-model arm is NOT equivalent at delta_tube, so the margin can distinguish something

kill: the reverse control does not reproduce M44's twelve point estimates to 1e-4 -> void
delta_tube falls outside [0.005, 0.20] -> the rule has produced a margin no experimenter would accept and the arm is reported as void rather than used

wording_rules.W1: the word equivalent may never appear without its margin named in the same sentence.
wording_rules.W2: if staked 1 fails for any arm, the manuscript sentence 'no implementation is distinguishable from a free integer' is replaced arm by arm, not softened globally.
wording_rules.W3: delta_star is a property of this corpus's resolution. A small delta_star means this corpus could resolve a small difference and did not find one; it is not a claim that no difference exists in the world.
wording_rules.W4: TOST establishes equivalence WITHIN a margin. It never establishes identity.

not_a_test: This run introduces no new outcome, no new predictor and no new corpus. It replaces one inferential argument with another on numbers already published.
